newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta cement stocks up; sector outlook positive.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta cement stocks up; sector outlook positive.

text.p: Indonesian cement stocks made strong gains in active late trading on Wednesday following improved sentiment on the sector and specific issues affecting each cement giant, brokers and analysts said.
Semen Gresik was up 150 rupiah at 5,300 rupiah, Indocement rose 200 rupiah to 4,300 rupiah and Semen Cibinong was up 225 rupiah at 3,850 rupiah.
"Recent worries over possible cement oversupply appeared to be overdone," a cement analyst with a local brokerage said.
"News reports that the Forestry Minister has proposed to stop providing new licences to build new cement factories in Java may have also boosted sentiment on the sector," the analyst said.
Java island accounts for some 60 percent of total cement demand in Indonesia, analysts said.

Analysts said Wednesday's news that a unit of the Medco group has secured loans to build a 1.1 trillion rupiah cement factory, with annual production capacity of 1.9 million tonnes, in central Java was unlikely to weaken sentiment on the sector as the news had been expected.

Brokers said reports that the government supported a proposed restructuring in Indocement, a unit of Indonesia's largest conglomerate the Salim Group, also boosted sentiment following sharp criticism that the deal would lead to an outflow of capital.
Indocement said on July 15 it proposed to sell its majority stake in noodle maker Indofood to Singapore-based QAF Limited, also controlled by the Salim group.
Semen Gresik has made a strong rebound over the past several days on expected encouraging first half results, brokers and analysts said.
Sentiment on Semen Cibinong got a boost following reports of a planned bonus issue, brokers said.
